$comment: Codes the bridge runtime adds to the api codes (session_required, request_timeout, internal, ...). kind refusal: sent to the browser as error.code with success false; an App may not return it. Texts for every UI locale of @synopackageland/sdk. kind service (added in v1): a service's refusal in svc_result; an App may pass it on to the browser as its own code. An api code may also have an entry of kind refusal (request_timeout, added in v1): the browser reads it in these words, and the api message stays a developer's text. APP_STOPPED and APP_STARTING (kind service): the executor client's codes for a stopped or starting package, which an App passes on; the browser may retry them. credential_not_ready (kind service): a signed-in browser's request without a SynoToken (a DSM session restored without a password sign-in, an Application Portal page); not temporary, the user signs in again.
